The memo appropriately captures all the key financial and material terms available in the source document. This is a technical amendment that only corrects language in Section 9.05(g) by inserting ", the Borrower or any of its Restricted Subsidiaries" after "Affiliated Lender." 

The source document does not contain specific financial terms like interest rates, loan amounts, or maturity dates because it is purely a technical correction amendment, not a substantive modification of commercial terms. The memo correctly identifies these terms as "N/A" and appropriately notes that all existing covenants, guarantees, and collateral arrangements are reaffirmed and continue in full force and effect.
